evidence_conventions.paths: WAR-internal paths are relative to the extracted WAR root (e.g. WEB-INF/web.xml). Shipped files are cited by line; decompiled classes are cited by class#member symbol, never by derived line number.

status_vocabulary.confirmed-static: read directly in shipped descriptor/config/JSP/bytecode; runtime not observed (Stage 2 is source-only)
status_vocabulary.inferred: reasoned from bytecode/config interaction; needs runtime confirmation at Stage 3
status_vocabulary.inert: shipped but not loaded/consumed by the deployed configuration (consumer search recorded)
status_vocabulary.broken-inferred: surface is wired but a referenced class/resource/bean is absent, so it is expected to fail at runtime

evidence_conventions.credential_rule: No password, key, token or login pair is reproduced. Locations are cited and behavior described (constitution A3; reviews/README.md Independence).

exhaustive_breakdowns.war-manifest.tsv: every file in the WAR (964 files) with sha256 and size
exhaustive_breakdowns.routes.json: all 87 live Struts action mappings (struts-config 74, mobile 7, test 6) cross-referenced to 80 Spring action beans, 46 global forwards, 24 form beans, forward/JSP existence
exhaustive_breakdowns.jsps.json: all 77 page files (73 JSP + 1 .tag + 3 HTML) with includes, forms, links, DB tags, scriptlet calls

items.title: Legacy package composition
items.detail: legacy/ contains exactly 4 files: XPlanner+ WAR, Russian-language README run notes, docker-compose run helper and a demo SQL fixture. The WAR has 1090 tar entries / 964 files: 594 classes under WEB-INF/classes (no Java sources), 103 jars, 73 JSPs, static assets, 11 message bundles and a shipped activity log.
items.uncertainty: No Java source: behavior inside method bodies is derived from bytecode disassembly (symbols, constants, branches).

items.title: Version and build identity
items.detail: xplanner.version=1.1a4, build date 04/12/2011, revision 426; Maven artifact net.sf:xplanner-plus; built with JDK 1.6.0_29.

items.title: Local MySQL configuration patch in the WAR
items.detail: Both xplanner.properties and the loaded override xplanner-custom.properties point Hibernate/DBCP at MySQL host 'db' database 'xplanner' with XPlannerMySQLDialect and a DB user/password (values not recorded). spring-beans.xml dataSource carries defaultAutoCommit=false with an explanatory comment about the password-change commit, which is the patch described by the run notes. README says the patch is in xplanner-custom.properties; the compose comment says xplanner.properties; the WAR has both set.
items.uncertainty: Which of the two files was edited cannot be determined without the upstream original; effective value is identical.

items.title: Local run helper (docker-compose) and context path
items.detail: Two services: MySQL 5.7 (utf8) with a named volume and healthcheck, and Tomcat 9 / JRE 8 on port 8080 with -Xverify:none and 256-768 MB heap. The WAR is mounted as xplanner-legacy.war, so the Tomcat context is /xplanner-legacy; README states http://localhost:8080/xplanner-plus and a default login (README:36-38). DB credentials appear inline in compose env and healthcheck (values not recorded).
items.uncertainty: Run helper, not application behavior; the /xplanner-plus vs /xplanner-legacy conflict is a documentation discrepancy.

items.title: Competing context-root and application URL declarations
items.detail: META-INF/context.xml path=/xplanner-plus (ignored by Tomcat for webapps/ deployments), sun-web.xml /xplanner-plus (GlassFish only), geronimo-web.xml /xplanner (Geronimo only). Effective xplanner.application.url is http://localhost:8080/xplanner from the override file (base file says /xplanner-plus). Consumers: net.sf.xplanner.context.ContextLoaderListener puts it in servlet-context attribute appUrl; EmailFormatterImpl uses it to fetch /css/email.css.
items.uncertainty: Effective URL mismatch with the deployed context (/xplanner-legacy) affects links in e-mails; runtime not observed.

items.title: Demo fixture excluded
items.detail: legacy/demo-seed.sql is a prepared demo fixture (authorized scope) and was deliberately not opened; it is not used as evidence of behavior.

items.title: Runtime library stack (103 jars)
items.detail: Struts 1.2.9 + Tiles, Spring 3.0.5 (core/web/webmvc/orm/tx/aop/struts), Hibernate 3.6.5 + JPA 2.0 API, javassist/cglib, commons-dbcp/pool, c3p0 0.9.0, Liquibase 2.0.1, tk-autopatch 0.7.3, Axis 1.4 (+jaxrpc, saaj, wsdl4j), Jersey 1.1.5 + jersey-spring 1.5 + Jackson 1.7.4, Quartz 1.5.2, Velocity 1.5, javax.mail 1.4.3, POI 3.5, iText 1.01, JasperReports 1.0.2, JFreeChart 1.0.11 + Cewolf 1.0, displaytag 1.0, EhCache 1.2.3, MySQL Connector/J 5.1.13, HSQLDB 2.2.4, jcifs 1.0.1 (NTLM), mpxj 3.0.1, radeox (wiki), xstream, betwixt, jetty 5.1.10, sitemesh 2.2.1, p6spy, log4j 1.2.15, slf4j 1.6.1.
items.uncertainty: Which jars are actually exercised is partly inferred (e.g. sitemesh, jetty, c3p0 have no configured consumer found).

items.title: Servlet inventory and URL mappings
items.detail: 6 live servlets / 7 mappings: XPlannerServlet (Struts, net.sf.xplanner.struts.XPlannerActionServlet) /do/*; Jersey SpringServlet /rest/* (POJO JSON on); CewolfRenderer /cewolf/* (load-on-startup 1); AxisServlet /servlet/AxisServlet and /soap/*; iCalServlet /ical/*; Spring DispatcherServlet (spring-web.xml) /setting/*. Commented out: JAX-WS WSServlet /service/*.

items.title: Filter chain and ordering
items.detail: 8 filters / 10 mappings in declaration order: ActivityLogFilter /do/*; ServletRequestFilter /*; OpenSessionInViewFilter /* (REQUEST, ERROR); HibernateSessionFilter /* (REQUEST, ERROR); MobileSecurityFilter /do/mobile/*; WebSecurityFilter (FormSecurityFilter) /do/* and /setting/*; BasicSecurityFilter /soap/* and /ical/*; RequestCharacterEncodingFilter (UTF-8) /do/* (runs after the security filters). NullSecurityFilter (auto-login as a default user) is commented out.
items.uncertainty: Encoding filter placed after security filters may not affect parameters already parsed by the security filter (inferred).

items.title: Context listeners (startup work)
items.detail: 5 live listeners in order: Spring Log4jConfigListener (log4j-war.xml, exposes webapp root as xplanner-plus.root); HsqldbServerContextListener (starts in-process HSQLDB only when xplanner.migration.databasetype=hsqldb; shipped value mysql, so not started); Spring ContextLoaderListener (spring-beans.xml); RequestContextListener; net.sf.xplanner.context.ContextLoaderListener (publishes iterationTypes and appUrl into the servlet context). Commented out: JAX-WS WSServletContextListener.

items.title: Schema creation and data seeding at application startup (Liquibase)
items.detail: Spring bean 'liquibase' (SpringLiquibase, contexts 'test, production') runs db-changelog.xml before the sessionFactory is built. 8 changesets: 1-1 create 19 tables (precondition: attribute absent); 1-2 keys, unique indexes, foreign keys (all NO ACTION); 1-3 seed 11 permissions, 4 roles, patch level 14, identifier nextId 19, person 1 'sysadmin' with a stored default password hash (value not recorded) and person_role sysadmin on project 0; 2-1 object_type and setting tables; 2-2 seed 7 object types; 2-3/2-4 add columns; 2-5 rename table role -> roles. Normal startup therefore mutates persistent data.
evidence: WEB-INF/classes/db-changelog.xml:5-498 (seed person at 396-411; password column at 404 not recorded)
items.uncertainty: Preconditions of 1-2/1-3 test object_type absence; behavior against an existing older schema not verified.

items.title: Duplicate Spring contexts (root and Struts plug-in)
items.detail: The root context loads spring-beans.xml (which imports caching, dao, security). The Struts ContextLoaderPlugIn separately loads action-servlet.xml, spring-beans.xml again and test-action-servlet.xml, so singletons such as dataSource, liquibase, sessionFactory, authorizer (AuthorizerInitializer re-sets SystemAuthorizer) and the task scheduler are instantiated twice. InvalidateCacheAction explicitly warns 'there are 2 Authorizers in the system'.
evidence: class com.technoetic.xplanner.actions.admin.InvalidateCacheAction#execute (string 'Configuration problem: there are 2 Authorizers in the system!')
items.uncertainty: Consequences (double scheduled job, second Liquibase run, two caches) need runtime confirmation.

items.title: Other startup side effects
items.detail: DaoScanner.init prints every DAO bean to stdout; XPlannerProperties loads xplanner.properties then the override file named by -Dxplanner.overrides (default xplanner-custom.properties); CewolfRenderer and SpringServlet load on startup (priority 1), Struts servlet priority 2.

items.title: Session, welcome and error-page configuration
items.detail: Session timeout 30 minutes; <distributable/>; welcome file index.jsp; JspException, ServletException and any Throwable map to /WEB-INF/jsp/common/unexpectedError.jsp; Struts global exceptions map ObjectNotFoundException/UnresolvableObjectException (error.objectNotFound) and AuthorizationException (security.notauthorized) to generalError.jsp.

items.title: Form security filter semantics (bypass-only)
items.detail: AbstractSecurityFilter.doFilter treats every request NOT matching the configured security-bypass list as secure and requires an authenticated subject; the security-constraint/auth-constraint role lists in security.xml are parsed but never evaluated (SecurityConfiguration.isAuthorized has no caller; positive control: SecurityConstraint.isAuthorized is found inside SecurityConfiguration). Authenticated = person principal in session attribute SECURITY_SUBJECT, or a valid remember-me cookie. On failure: remove cookie, save the URL for GET requests (SAVED_URL) and redirect to context + authenticatorUrl.

items.title: Web bypass list
items.detail: /do/login, /do/notAuthorized and /do/invalidateHibernateCache pass the web filter without authentication. /do/invalidateHibernateCache evicts all Hibernate query caches (SessionFactory.evictQueries) for anyone.
items.uncertainty: Response body after eviction not determined (execute returns without a mapped JSP; input JSP /WEB-INF/jsp/admin/invalidateCache.jsp is absent).

items.title: Mobile channel login is shadowed by the web filter
items.detail: /do/mobile/* passes MobileSecurityFilter (bypass /do/mobile/login and /do/mobile/notAuthorized) and then WebSecurityFilter (/do/*), whose bypass list does not contain /do/mobile/login. An unauthenticated mobile login request is therefore redirected to /do/login; the mobile pages are reachable only with an existing web session or remember-me cookie.
items.uncertainty: Filter order per declaration order of filter-mappings; runtime not observed.

items.title: HTTP Basic authentication for SOAP and iCal
items.detail: BasicSecurityFilter on /soap/* and /ical/*; soap-security.xml has no bypass so every request is secure. Accepted: session subject, or 'Authorization: Basic' header decoded (Base64 user:password) and authenticated through the same Authenticator (logged on failure). Failure: WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="XPlanner" with an error status.
items.uncertainty: Exact status code constant not decoded (setStatus argument).

items.title: Paths with no security filter
items.detail: No security filter covers /rest/* (Jersey API, see A-103), /servlet/AxisServlet (SOAP via the second mapping, see A-104), /cewolf/* (chart images), /index.jsp and /calendar/calendar-i18n.jsp (public JSPs), static files (css, js, images, flash, calendar, ui, files/*.xls templates) and the shipped /xplanner-plus-activity.log.

items.title: Login flow
items.detail: GET/POST /do/login (DynaActionForm userId, password, action, loginModuleNames). Empty 'action' shows /WEB-INF/jsp/security/login.jsp. Otherwise Authenticator.authenticate (logs out a previous subject first), stores Subject in session; remember=Y sets credential cookies; redirects to the saved URL or /do/view/projects. AuthenticationException -> login.failed global message plus per-module messages (moduleMessages) and the login page again.
items.uncertainty: Session is not renewed on login (no invalidate/new session call found) - session fixation inferred.

items.title: Configured login modules
items.detail: Only login[0] XPlannerLoginModule named 'XPlanner' with userIdCaseSensitive=true is configured. JAAS, NTLM (jcifs) and JNDI/LDAP (com.sabre.security.jndi) module beans exist but are not referenced by any xplanner.security.login[n] property.
items.uncertainty: Other modules inert unless properties are added.

items.title: Password verification and storage
items.detail: Person looked up by userid; missing password -> passwordNotSet; stored value is Base64(12-byte random salt + MD5(salt + UTF-8 password)); mismatch -> authenticationFailed; unknown user -> userNotFound; DB error -> storageError. changePassword re-encodes with a new salt and commits the JDBC connection manually.

items.title: Remember-me credential cookie
items.detail: remember=Y creates cookies 'userid' (plain) and 'password' (Base64 of the clear password) with max-age Integer.MAX_VALUE, no path/HttpOnly/Secure set. FormSecurityFilter re-authenticates from these cookies when no session subject exists; on failure the cookies are deleted.

items.title: Logout
items.detail: /do/logout calls the login module logout (session invalidate), removes the credential cookies and forwards to security/login (-> /do/login). An AOP advisor on 'logout' invalidates the cached permissions of that principal.

items.title: Credentials present in shipped files (locations only)
items.detail: Password-bearing locations: DB password in xplanner.properties:15 and xplanner-custom.properties:24 (also in other unused custom variants); xplanner.test.user/xplanner.test.password at xplanner.properties:139-140; Axis adminPassword at WEB-INF/server-config.wsdd:4; seeded default password hash for person 'sysadmin' at db-changelog.xml:404; run helpers: docker-compose.yml:16,19,23 and README.md:38 (default login pair). None of the values is recorded here.
items.uncertainty: Whether the seeded hash matches the README login pair was not tested (no runtime; no hashing performed).

items.title: Role model
items.detail: Four hierarchical roles stored as a nested set in table roles: viewer(lft1,rgt8) > editor(2,7) > admin(3,6) > sysadmin(4,5). person_role links person, role and project; project_id 0 is the wildcard 'all projects' (security.roles query includes it when includeWildcardProject=1).

items.title: Seeded permission rules
items.detail: sysadmin: '%' on '%'. admin: 'admin%' on '%'; denied create.project. editor: create%, edit%, integrate%, delete% on '%'; denied create.project, create.person and delete on system.project.iteration. viewer: read%. Positive permissions of weaker roles are inherited by stronger roles; negative permissions apply to the exact role only.
items.uncertainty: Per-role outcome of combined positive/negative rules at runtime not observed.

items.title: Permission evaluation engine
items.detail: AuthorizerImpl.hasPermission(principal, project, resourceType, resourceId, permission) resolves the resource type from the domain class (system.project, .iteration, .story, .task, .feature, .time_entry, .integration, system.person, system.note, system.setting), loads per-principal permission lists (role-inherited + personal), matches names/types with trailing '%' wildcards and resource id 0 = any, falls back to ANY_PROJECT (0). Results are cached in a shared HashMap via MethodCacheInterceptor (getAllPermissions, getAllPermissionsToPerson, getPermissionsForPrincipal) and invalidated on modifyRoles and logout; /do/invalidateCache clears the map.

items.title: No server-side authorization in generic view/edit/delete/export actions
items.detail: ViewObjectAction, EditObjectAction (and subclasses), DeleteObjectAction, ExportAction and DownloadAttachmentAction load/save/delete through CommonDao/Session directly; the secure repository chain (secureObjectRepositoryFactory with RepositorySecurityAdapter read/edit/delete checks) is consumed only by IntegrationEmailNotifier. Consequently any authenticated person (any role, including none) can view, create, update, delete or export any object by oid via /do/* URLs; UI tags only hide the buttons.
items.uncertainty: Strong bytecode evidence; must be confirmed live at Stage 3 with a viewer-role account.

items.title: Authorization checks that do exist
items.detail: DispatchForward (secure unless authorizationRequired=false or @secure forward false): requires projectId and read on system.project, else forward security/notAuthorized - applies to /do/view/integrations and the mobile pages; EditRoleAction and EditPersonHelper.modifyRoles require admin.edit.role on the project; content search and aggregate timesheet filter results by read; iCal feed for another person requires admin.edit on system.person for some project; SOAP methods check read/edit/create/delete (see A-104); InvalidateCacheAction has an authorizer but only for a consistency message.

items.title: UI-level authorization (rendering)
items.detail: Tags xplanner:isUserAuthorized, isUserAuthorizedForAny, isUserInRole, outline, personOptions, writableTable and link/action tags consult the Authorizer to show/hide actions; action button permissions are configured as actionbuttons.permission.edit.project=admin.edit, delete.project=sysadmin.delete, edit=edit, delete=delete, movecontinue=edit, edittime=edit.
items.uncertainty: Consumer of actionbuttons.* keys not traced to a class (property keys found only in properties).

items.title: Not-authorized target page missing
items.detail: Global forward security/notAuthorized points to /WEB-INF/jsp/security/notAuthorized.jsp which is not in the WAR; /do/notAuthorized (bypassed) dispatches to the same missing page. Any DispatchForward denial therefore ends in a container error instead of a message page.
items.uncertainty: Runtime response (404 or error page) not observed.

items.title: Projects list
items.detail: /do/view/projects (DispatchForward, authorizationRequired=false) renders projects.jsp: visible projects with current iteration, links to edit project, people and aggregate timesheet.
items.uncertainty: Filtering of hidden projects / per-user visibility inside the JSP not fully traced.

items.title: Project view
items.detail: /do/view/project?oid (ViewObjectAction type Project) sets domain context and renders project.jsp: iterations list, create/edit iteration links, people, history, export links.

items.title: Project create/update
items.detail: /do/edit/project (EditProjectAction, form ProjectEditorForm; validation project.editor.missing_name). Create/Update via action=Create|Update; stores project attributes twiki.scheme.wiki (wiki URL), xplanner.project.send.notification (missing time entry reminder to acceptor) and xplanner.escape.brackets through AttributeDao. action=addTimeNotification|delTimeNotification forwards to /do/edit/project/notification.

items.title: Project time-notification receivers
items.detail: /do/edit/project/notification (UpdateTimeNotificationReceivers): addTimeNotification adds personToAddId to project.notificationReceivers (join table notification_receivers); delTimeNotification removes personToDelete; unknown action -> ServletException; re-renders editProject.jsp.

items.title: Project delete and cascade
items.detail: /do/delete/project?oid (DeleteObjectAction): publishes a delete event (no listener) and Session.delete. JPA cascades: Project.iterations ALL -> Iteration.userStories REMOVE -> UserStory.tasks REMOVE -> Task.timeEntries REMOVE; Project.backlog REMOVE; notification_receivers rows (owned many-to-many) removed. Not cleaned: notes attached by attachedToId, attributes, person_role rows for the project, history. No history 'deleted' event is written. Redirect to returnto or view/projects.
evidence: consumer search: NoteHelper.deleteNotesFor only from HibernateObjectRepository
items.uncertainty: Orphan behavior and FK outcomes need runtime/DB confirmation.

items.title: Iteration views (tabs)
items.detail: ViewObjectAction type Iteration: /do/view/iteration (stories table, reorder, move multiple), /iteration/tasks, /iteration/features, /iteration/metrics (ViewIterationMetricsAction: IterationMetrics.analyze -> developer metrics), /iteration/statistics (charts), /iteration/accuracy. Shared tile params include links, global links (dashboard, export), progress bar.

items.title: Iteration create/edit
items.detail: /do/edit/iteration (EditIterationAction, IterationEditorForm; validation missing_name, bad_start_date, bad_end_date). On Create: sets project from projectId, status INACTIVE, daysWorked.
items.uncertainty: Value assigned to daysWorked not decoded.

items.title: Start iteration (wizard)
items.detail: /do/start/iteration (StartIterationAction): without confirmation shows editIterationStatus.jsp with the number of already started iterations; with closeIterations closes other active iterations of the project; sets ACTIVE and starts stories, generates opening data samples, writes history 'started'. When entered from time entry (saveTime) it continues to /do/edit/time in wizard_mode.

items.title: Close iteration
items.detail: /do/close/iteration (CloseIterationAction): if active -> INACTIVE, closing data samples, history 'closed'; redirects (onclose) to /do/continue/unfinished/stories?iterationId=... unless returnto given.

items.title: Continue unfinished stories
items.detail: /do/continue/unfinished/stories (ContinueUnfinishedStoriesAction): action Ok continues every incomplete story of the closed iteration into the target iteration via StoryContinuer (clone story and incomplete tasks, postpone remaining hours, dispositions ADDED/CARRIED_OVER, notes copied, description and history 'continued'); validation rejects the same iteration; errors roll back the JDBC connection.

items.title: Iteration delete and cascade
items.detail: /do/delete/iteration (DeleteObjectAction type Iteration; form name iterationEditorForm is undefined): cascades to stories, tasks and time entries; attached notes, attributes and data samples remain; editor role has a negative 'delete' on system.project.iteration but it is enforced only in the UI.
items.uncertainty: Struts behavior with an undefined form-bean name not verified.

items.title: Reorder stories and move multiple stories
items.detail: /do/edit/reorderstories (ReorderStoriesAction; validation story.editor.invalid.order.number) applies orderNo values to Iteration.modifyStoryOrder and redirects to the iteration; client-side jQuery UI drag-and-drop renumbers rows only when sorted by order ascending and editable. /do/move/userstories (MoveStoriesAction) moves checked stories to a target iteration with history and reordering.

items.title: User story view/create/edit
items.detail: /do/view/userstory; /do/edit/userstory (EditStoryAction, UserStoryEditorForm; validation missing_name, negative_estimated_hours, invalid_priority, same_iteration). New story gets disposition from the iteration (ADDED if active else PLANNED) and next order number; saving assigns iteration and re-sequences order. Default priority property xplanner.story.defaultpriority=4.

items.title: Move or continue a story
items.detail: /do/move/continue/userstory (MoveContinueStoryAction): Move -> story moved to target iteration, order adjusted, history 'moved'/'moved out'/'moved in'; Continue -> StoryContinuer clone into target; validation missing_name / same_iteration; unknown action -> ServletException.

items.title: Story delete and cascade
items.detail: /do/delete/userstory (DeleteObjectAction type UserStory; form userStoryEditorForm undefined): cascades to tasks and time entries; notes by attachedToId remain; no history.

items.title: Task view/create/edit with e-mail notification
items.detail: /do/view/task; /do/edit/task (EditTaskAction, TaskEditorForm; validation bad_created_date, missing_name, negative_estimated_hours). New task disposition from iteration; saving sets userStory from userStoryId. After a redirecting save it e-mails the acceptor: template email_notification_task_created.vm on Create, email_notification_task_updated.vm when the acceptor changed (subjects task.created.subject / task.updated.subject), and prints 'Email was sent to:' to stdout.
items.uncertainty: Exact conditions for the update mail (acceptor change vs any change) partially decoded.

items.title: Move or continue a task
items.detail: /do/move/continue/task (MoveContinueTaskAction, session-scoped form; validation missing_name, same_story): Continue clones the task into the target story (TaskContinuer: postpone, remaining hours as estimate, no time entries); Move reassigns the story and sets disposition from story/iteration state (DISCOVERED/CARRIED_OVER/PLANNED/ADDED) with history 'moved'/'moved out'/'moved in'; manual commit/rollback.

items.title: Task delete and cascade
items.detail: /do/delete/task (DeleteObjectAction type Task): cascades to time entries; notes remain; no history.

items.title: Time entry editing and re-estimation
items.detail: /do/edit/time (UpdateTimeAction, TimeEditorForm; validation unparsable_time, unparsable_number, missing_time, missing_person, same_people, negative_interval). UPDATE_TIME: per row delete/update/create time entries (start/end/duration/person1/person2/report date/description), start the task on first effort, set remaining hours; if the task's iteration is not active the form is saved in session and the user is sent to /do/start/iteration first. UPDATE_ESTIMATE: history 'reestimated' and new estimate. /do/edit/task/estimate is a plain Struts Action showing editTaskEstimate.jsp that posts to /do/edit/time.

items.title: Notes with attachments
items.detail: /do/edit/note (EditNoteAction, NoteEditorForm; validation missing_subject, missing_author, missing_body): optional multipart file stored as a BLOB xfile in virtual directory /attachments/project/{projectId}; note linked by attachedToId. /do/delete/note (DeleteNoteAction) deletes the note and its file when no other note references it. Notes are listed in view footers (notes.jsp) with edit/delete/download links.
items.uncertainty: Upload size limits not configured in struts controller (defaults).

items.title: Attachment download
items.detail: /do/download/attachment?oid (DownloadAttachmentAction): loads the note by id (HQL with the parsed integer), streams the BLOB with the stored content type and Content-disposition 'note;filename="..."'; bad oid logged. No permission check.

items.title: People list and person view
items.detail: /do/view/people (DispatchForward, authorizationRequired=false) lists people (hidden last) with edit/import links. /do/view/person?oid (ViewPersonAction, authorizationRequired=false) shows current active/pending/completed tasks, future tasks, stories where customer or tracker, timesheet link, export (jrpdf).

items.title: Person create/edit, roles and password
items.detail: /do/edit/person (EditPersonAction, PersonEditorForm; validation missing_name, missing_user_id, missing_email, missing_initials, password_mismatch; DuplicateUserIdException -> person.editor.userid_exist). Per-project role map applied through EditPersonHelper.modifyRoles only for projects where the current user has admin.edit.role; sysadmin flag adds/removes the sysadmin association on project 0; permission cache invalidated; new password (if non-empty) changed via the login module after commit.
items.uncertainty: Whether the sysadmin flag change is itself permission-checked was not fully decoded.

items.title: Person delete
items.detail: /do/delete/person (DeleteObjectAction type Person): plain Session.delete; person_role rows, time entries (person1_id/person2_id without FK), notification_receivers FK and story.customer_id FK (NO ACTION) are not handled, so deletion of a referenced person is expected to fail on FK or leave orphans.

items.title: Import people from CSV
items.detail: /do/import/people (ImportPeopleAction overrides execute): uploaded text file, one person per line 'userId,name,email,initials,phone'; statuses success, wrong_entry_format, empty_userId, userId_exists; AuthorizationException -> security/notAuthorized. The action saves through a personDao property but no 'personDao' bean is defined (autowire byName), so saving is expected to fail with a null reference.
evidence: consumer search: no personDao bean in any Spring XML (positive control: taskDao found at spring-dao.xml:21)

items.title: Import stories from spreadsheet
items.detail: /do/import/stories (ImportStoriesAction, ImportStoriesForm; validation worksheet_name, no_title_column, no_end_date_column, no_priority_column, no_completed_story_status): Excel (POI HSSF) worksheet 'Features' with configurable headers (title, estimate, iteration end date, status, priority), optional only-incomplete (completed status 'C'); stories appended to the iteration; header settings remembered in persistent cookies; errors corrupted_file, missing_required_field, wrong_header, worksheet_not_found.

items.title: Personal timesheet
items.detail: /do/view/timesheet (ViewTimesheetAction, PersonTimesheetForm; validation unparsable_date): parameterized JDBC queries summarize time by project/iteration/story and per day for one person and date range; charts via Cewolf.

items.title: Aggregate timesheet (HQL built from request values)
items.detail: /do/view/aggregateTimesheet (ViewAggregateTimesheetAction, AggregateTimesheetForm; validation unparsable_date): lists non-hidden people; for selected people and date range sums time per project/iteration/story; rows are kept only when the viewer has read on the project; three pie charts. selectedPeople strings are concatenated into 'AND person.id IN (...)' without numeric validation (HQL injection).

items.title: Iteration dashboard (client-side)
items.detail: /do/view/dashboard?fkey=iterationId (DispatchForward, authorizationRequired=false) renders dashboard.jsp, whose jQuery code calls GET {appPath}rest/view/iteration/{fkey}/userstories and renders story/task cards with jqote templates; ${param.fkey} is written unescaped into the script URL.

items.title: Integration queue
items.detail: /do/view/integrations?projectId (DispatchForward, secure: needs projectId and read) and /do/edit/integrations (IntegrationAction): join (personId, comment; integrations.error.noperson), leave (action.leave<oid>), start (integrations.error.alreadyactive), finish, cancel; listeners from xplanner.integration.listeners (IntegrationEmailNotifier) e-mail the person unless nonotify. The action persists com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Integration, which is not a mapped entity (only net.sf.xplanner.domain.Integration is scanned), so writes are expected to fail.
items.uncertainty: Hibernate behavior for the unmapped class not observed.

items.title: History view
items.detail: /do/view/history?oid&@type (ViewObjectAction without fixed type: class from request parameter @type via Class.forName) renders history.jsp with object events and container create/delete events (HistorySupport).

items.title: Virtual file manager
items.detail: /do/view/directory (FileManagerAction, form view/file): list (root directory auto-created on first access), upload, download, delete file, mkdir, rmdir on DB-stored xdir/xfile; commit/rollback manually; ObjectNotFound -> error/objectNotFound. No permission checks.

items.title: Settings
items.detail: /do/view/settings (DispatchForward, authorizationRequired=false) lists Setting rows (settings.jsp); /do/edit/setting (EditObjectAction type Setting) has input /WEB-INF/jsp/edit/editSetting.jsp which is absent, so editing is expected to fail.

items.title: Project role editor
items.detail: /do/edit/roles (EditRoleAction, session-scoped RoleEditorForm, type Project): for each listed person, if the current user has admin.edit.role on the project, delete that person's associations on the project and insert the chosen role.

items.title: Search by id and content search
items.detail: /do/search/id (IdSearchAction): searchedId required/integer (idsearch.error.missingId, badId, idNotFound) and redirects to /do/view/{type}?oid. /do/search/content (ContentSearchAction): searchedContent required ('contentsearch.invalid_id' message), optional restrictToProjectId, global scope allowed (search.content.globalScopeEnable=true); named LIKE queries over projects, iterations, stories, tasks, notes; numeric input also tried as id; results filtered by read permission; searchResults.jsp.

items.title: Exports
items.detail: ExportAction routes: project xml/mpx/mspdi; iteration xml/mpx/mspdi/pdf/jrpdf; story pdf/jrpdf; task pdf/jrpdf; person jrpdf. XML (Betwixt, hides password and lastUpdateTime; text/xml export.xml), MPX (application/mpx export.mpx), MSPDI (application/mspdi export.xml), PDF (iText, application/pdf export.pdf), JasperReports (report.pdf) which loads com/technoetic/xplanner/export/reports/JR*.jrxml - these resources are absent from the WAR and all jars, so jrpdf exports are expected to fail. Errors roll back and raise ExportException. Configured formats xml,mpx,mspdi,pdf,jrpdf.
evidence: jar search: no *.jrxml/*.jasper (positive control struts Action.class found)

items.title: Wiki format help and locale change
items.detail: /do/view/twikiformat (DispatchForward, no authorization) shows formatting help. /do/changeLocale?language&returnto sets the Struts locale in session (default JVM locale when empty) and redirects. Bundles: default, da, de, es, fr, it, ja, pt_br, ru plus ResourceBundle--.properties and EmailResourceBundle; Spring ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource UTF-8, no system-locale fallback.
items.uncertainty: Purpose of ResourceBundle--.properties unknown (no locale suffix).

items.title: System information page
items.detail: /do/systemInfo (SystemInfoAction) forwards to unexpectedError.jsp in system-info mode for any authenticated user: build info, database dialect/driver/vendor/URL/user (password shown as ******), app server, JVM memory, system properties, request details, all request parameters and attributes.

items.title: Unexpected error page content
items.detail: unexpectedError.jsp shows the first 3 words-lines of the exception message unescaped, filing instructions with support URL, exception toString and full stack trace, system environment and request parameters/attributes, then logs 'JSP error'. It is the container error page for all Throwables, including errors on unauthenticated paths.

items.title: General error page
items.detail: generalError.jsp renders Struts errors for mapped exceptions and 'error' forwards (object not found, not authorized) using request parameter oid.

items.title: Tiles definitions reload
items.detail: /do/admin/reload-tiles (Struts ReloadDefinitionsAction) reloads tile definitions for any authenticated user.

items.title: Test/support actions live in production configuration
items.detail: test-struts-config.xml is loaded by the Struts servlet and test-action-servlet.xml by the plug-in, exposing to any authenticated user: /do/edit/dataSample (runs data sampling for iterations to sample), /do/edit/missingTimeEntryNotification (sends the missing-time e-mails immediately), /do/edit/putTheClockForward?dayOffset (shifts or resets the application TimeGenerator clock used for dates), /do/edit/properties?propertyName&propertyValue (changes an in-memory XPlanner property at runtime), /do/invalidateCache (clears the permission cache). /do/invalidateHibernateCache is additionally unauthenticated (A-021).
items.uncertainty: Response pages after execution not determined (input JSP /WEB-INF/jsp/admin/invalidateCache.jsp absent).

items.title: Feature management routes (broken)
items.detail: /do/view/feature, /do/edit/feature, /do/delete/feature and the feature links in project/iteration feature pages use type net.sf.xplanner.domain.Feature, which does not exist; com.technoetic.xplanner.domain.Feature exists but is not a mapped entity and UserStory.getFeatures is @Transient. Feature validation key feature.editor.missing_name exists in FeatureEditorForm.

items.title: Missing forward targets and undefined form beans
items.detail: Missing pages: /WEB-INF/jsp/security/notAuthorized.jsp, /WEB-INF/jsp/view/iterationTabs.jsp (/do/view/iterationTabs), global forwards view/iteration/statistics -> iterationIterations.jsp, view/taskhistory -> taskhistory.jsp, view/text -> viewtext.jsp, image/calendar -> /images/calendar.png, /WEB-INF/jsp/edit/editSetting.jsp, /WEB-INF/jsp/admin/invalidateCache.jsp. Undefined form-bean names: iterationEditorForm, featureEditorForm, userStoryEditorForm, edit/task/estimate, /download/attachment, edit/properties.
items.uncertainty: Runtime impact per route not observed.

items.title: Mobile/WAP channel
items.detail: 7 routes /do/mobile/login, /do/mobile/view/{projects,project,iteration,story,task,person} rendering WML pages in WEB-INF/jsp/wap. No Spring beans exist for these paths, so Struts instantiates AuthenticationAction/DispatchForward itself (verified: DelegatingTilesRequestProcessor falls back when containsBean is false), leaving authenticator/authorizer unset; DispatchForward is secure by default and without projectId forwards to the missing notAuthorized page, and with a projectId would dereference a null authorizer; mobile login would dereference a null authenticator. WML pages load objects directly through db tags. See also A-022.

items.title: Unreachable WAP auth page echoing credentials
items.detail: WEB-INF/jsp/wap/auth.jsp prints request parameters userId and password and sets a test cookie; no action or forward references it, and WEB-INF content is not directly addressable.

items.title: Spring MVC channel /setting/*
items.detail: DispatcherServlet with annotation mapping scans net.sf.xplanner.web: MePage GET /setting/me/status/{id} -> view view/meStatus (/WEB-INF/jsp/view/meStatus.jsp) with the person's current/pending/completed/future tasks and stories as customer/tracker; CommonObjectHandler /setting/{objectType}/list and /setting/{objectType}/edit/{objectId} only print to stdout and return a view name. Protected by the web form filter.
items.uncertainty: View resolution for CommonObjectHandler return values not traced (likely missing JSPs).

items.title: REST API (Jersey) without authentication
items.detail: Component-scanned net.sf.xplanner.rest resources under /rest/*: GET /rest/view (text 'Hi there!'); GET /rest/view/project/{projectId} (ProjectView XML/JSON); GET /rest/view/iteration/{iterationId}/userstories (UserStoryView list incl. tasks); POST /rest/update/task/{taskId}/status (form-encoded; status name and a numeric value): not found -> 'Task not found'; unchanged -> 'Task status not changed'; NON_STARTED -> 'Moving Task to not started not implemented'; STARTED sets original estimate; COMPLETED marks completed; saves the task and returns Result (error, code, description). No security filter or permission check applies.
items.uncertainty: Form parameter names of POST not decoded (annotations on parameters not parsed by the reviewer tool).

items.title: SOAP API (Axis 1.4)
items.detail: server-config.wsdd deploys service 'XPlanner' (RPC, allowedMethods '*', class com.technoetic.xplanner.soap.XPlanner) and 'Version' (getVersion); bean mappings for ProjectData, IterationData, UserStoryData, TaskData, FeatureData, TimeEntryData, NoteData, PersonData. Operations: get/add/remove/update for projects, iterations, user stories, tasks, time entries, notes, persons; getProjects, getCurrentIteration, getIterations, getUserStories, getTasks, getCurrentTasksForPerson, getPlannedTasksForPerson, getTimeEntries, getNotesForObject, getPeople; set/get/delete/getAttributes/getAttributesWithPrefix. Read/list filtered by read permission; add/update/remove check create/edit/delete and write history (created/updated/deleted). Attribute methods and person task methods perform no permission check. No AdminService is deployed; JWSHandler is in the global request flow but no .jws files exist.

items.title: SOAP reachable without the Basic filter
items.detail: AxisServlet is also mapped to /servlet/AxisServlet, which no security filter covers. Methods that call getRemoteUserId fail without a session subject, but attribute get/set/delete and person task queries do not require it, and Axis service listing/WSDL is served.

items.title: iCalendar feed
items.detail: GET /ical/{userId}.ics (Basic/session auth): requires path and .ics suffix ('No iCal file requested.', 'No .ics suffix ...'); another user's calendar requires admin.edit on system.person for some project ('No authorization for accessing calendar for ...'); output VCALENDAR with VEVENT per time entry and VTODO per open non-overhead task accepted by the user (percent complete, priority, URL to /do/view/task). HQL uses 'task.story', while the mapped property is userStory.
items.uncertainty: The 'task.story' property path may fail at runtime (inferred).

items.title: Chart image servlet
items.detail: /cewolf/* (CewolfRenderer, overlib at ../../../overlib.js, debug false) serves chart images produced by cewolf tags in aggregateTimesheet.jsp, timesheet.jsp and iterationStatistics.jsp; not behind a security filter.
items.uncertainty: Whether images are bound to the producing session not verified.

items.title: Welcome page executes a query before login
items.detail: /index.jsp (welcome file, no filter) queries non-hidden projects via db:useBeans; 0 or >1 projects -> redirect /do/view/projects; exactly one project -> redirect to its current iteration (/do/view/iteration?oid=) or projects. The redirect target reveals project/iteration existence to anonymous users.

items.title: Shipped and live activity log served as a static file
items.detail: log4j ACTIVITY_FILE writes ${xplanner-plus.root}/xplanner-plus-activity.log (webapp root, 5 MB x 50) from ActivityLogFilter START/END records (time, user id, remote IP, action, duration) for every /do/* request. The WAR already ships a 216-line xplanner-plus-activity.log with user and IP entries from the build machine; files in the webapp root are downloadable without authentication.
items.uncertainty: Static serving of .log by Tomcat default servlet is standard behavior, not observed.

items.title: JSP pages load entities directly
items.detail: db:useBean (Session.load by oid attribute/parameter) and db:useBeans (HQL from type/where/order attributes, all literal in JSPs) run during rendering without authorization, e.g. editRoles.jsp, person.jsp, people.jsp, iteration pages, wap pages, index.jsp; Hibernate substitutions true='1',false='0' applied by UseBeansTag.

items.title: Wiki/TWiki formatting of descriptions
items.detail: xplanner:twiki renders descriptions/notes through TwikiFormat: HTML is escaped only when property xplanner.escape.brackets is 'true' (per project attribute; not set in xplanner.properties), otherwise raw HTML passes through; supports headings, lists, tables, code, wiki schemes (sourceforge, cvs, jira, c2 wiki, project/iteration/story/task links, ClearQuest cq via xplanner.scr.scheme.url).
items.uncertainty: Stored-script behavior not tested; default of the escape flag inferred from absence of the key.

items.title: Outbound HTTP during page rendering
items.detail: twiki.wikiadapter=GenericWikiAdapter formats WikiWords as links to twiki.wikiadapter.topic.url.existing/new (http://localhost:9090/vqw/...) and checks topic existence with HttpClient.getPage, i.e. a server-side HTTP GET while rendering text containing wiki words.
items.uncertainty: Call path from TwikiFormat to GenericWikiAdapter not fully decoded.

items.title: Request context attributes
items.detail: ServletRequestFilter binds the request to a thread-local and sets request attributes currentPageUrl (URL + query) and appPath (absolute context URL) used by layouts and the dashboard script.

items.title: Rendering-path writes
items.detail: Reads that write: FileSystemImpl.getRootDirectory saves a root directory when none exists (file manager, note attachment); UseBeans/Outline tags only read. Page layouts (viewLayout, defaultLayout, defaultEditLayout, viewLayoutNew) include header/footer/notes and breadcrumb tag.

items.title: Datasource and transactions
items.detail: Commons DBCP BasicDataSource from hibernate.connection.* properties with defaultAutoCommit=false; HibernateTransactionManager; tx:annotation-driven for DAOs (@Transactional); AbstractAction runs doExecute and beforeObjectCommit inside CheckedExceptionHandlingTransactionTemplate; several actions also commit/rollback the raw JDBC connection; OpenSessionInViewFilter + HibernateSessionFilter bind one session per request (ThreadSession/HibernateHelper).

items.title: Entity model
items.detail: 21 annotated entities scanned from net.sf.xplanner.domain: Attribute(attribute), DataSample(datasample), Directory(xdir), File(xfile), History(history), Identifier(identifier), Integration(integration), Iteration(iteration), Note(note), NotificationReceivers(notification_receivers), ObjectType(object_type), Patches(patches), Permission(permission), Person(person, unique userId), PersonRole(person_role), Project(project), Role(roles, unique role), Setting(setting, single-table with object_type discriminator), Task(task), TimeEntry(time_entry), UserStory(story). IDs via GenericGenerator 'commonId' (HibernateIdentityGenerator) using table identifier.nextId.

items.title: Loaded and unloaded mapping files
items.detail: Only classpath:/mappings/Metrics.xml (named HQL queries) is loaded. The other 16 hbm files in WEB-INF/classes/mappings and hibernate.reveng.xml are not referenced by any configuration (inert).
evidence: consumer search for 'mappings/' in all XML/properties and disassembly (only spring-beans.xml:80)

items.title: Named queries and their consumers
items.detail: Metrics.xml queries: iterationHoursWorkedQuery, namesQuery, IterationToSample (DataSamplingCommand), Iteration/Note/Project/Task/UserStory search and restricted search (SearchContentQuery), GetCurrentIterationQuery, GetEditableIterationQuery, NoteAttachedNotesQuery (Continuer), security.roles / security.role.permissions / security.personal.permissions / security.person.permissions (authorizer query helpers), CheckPersonUniquenessQuery, tasks.current.accepted / tasks.current.worked / tasks.planned.future (task queries), TimeEntryEmailNotificationToProjectSpecificLeads / ToAcceptors (MissingTimeEntryNotifier via TaskQueryHelper), stories.customer / stories.tracker, StoriesOfCurrentAndFutureIterationOfAllVisibleProjects (story options).
items.uncertainty: Consumer mapping for each query partially inferred from class names.

items.title: Hibernate cache and dialect properties not passed to Hibernate
items.detail: xplanner.properties declares hibernate.cache.* (EhCache provider, query and second-level cache on), hibernate.dbcp.* pool settings, hibernate.dialect and hibernate.show_sql, but the AnnotationSessionFactoryBean receives only dataSource, packagesToScan and mappingLocations (no hibernateProperties). Consumers found: hibernate.dialect/driver/url/username read by SystemInfo and the dataSource; hibernate.query.substitutions read by UseBeansTag. Cache/pool keys and ehcache.xml have no consumer found.
items.uncertainty: Hibernate could read a hibernate.properties resource (none in the WAR); dialect auto-detection behavior not observed.

items.title: History records
items.detail: History rows are written only by start/close iteration, continue (story/task), move story/task, re-estimate and SOAP create/update/delete; updated events are throttled. Web create/update/delete publish Spring events (ObjectCreated/Updated/Deleted) for which no listener is registered (EmailPerChangeListener is not a bean), so they leave no history and send no mail.
evidence: consumer search: no XML bean and no component-scan package for net.sf.xplanner.email

items.title: Data samples for burn-down charts
items.detail: DataSamplerImpl saves estimatedHours, actualHours and remainingHours samples per iteration and day (update if exists); optional end-date auto-extension disabled (iteration.automatically.extend.endDate=false). Triggered by start/close iteration and /do/edit/dataSample.

items.title: Object attributes (domain-specific properties)
items.detail: attribute(targetId,name,value) stores per-object settings; DomainSpecificPropertiesFactory overlays project attributes on global properties (wiki URL, send notification, escape brackets); SOAP exposes generic attribute CRUD.

items.title: Property loading and override variants
items.detail: XPlannerProperties loads classpath xplanner.properties and overlays the file named by system property xplanner.overrides (default xplanner-custom.properties). Seven other variants (apdbuild3, apdbuild6, before-standalone-install-backup, production, standalone-install, template, war-install) are not loaded by default.
items.uncertainty: A -Dxplanner.overrides value in the run helper was not found (CATALINA_OPTS lacks it).

items.title: Mail configuration
items.detail: xplanner.mail.smtp.host=localhost, port 25, from xplanner@xplannerplus.org; optional xplanner.mail.smtp.user/password (absent) switch on SMTP auth and STARTTLS; project send-notification default true; integration CC empty.

items.title: Charts, statistics and UI properties
items.detail: Burndown and progress charts displayed, velocity not; chart 800x400 including weekends; progress bar html; statistics on; export banner labels; login.instructions.url (override points to project documentation).
items.uncertainty: Consumers of several keys not traced individually.

items.title: Other configuration files
items.detail: log4j-war.xml (console + activity appenders; FILE appender unreferenced); ehcache.xml (no consumer, A-124); spy.properties (p6spy; driver not configured as P6Spy, inert); TableTag.properties (displaytag export types csv/excel/xml; no table enables export); tacitknowledge hsqldb.properties; velocity engine classpath loader with 3 templates; tiles-definitions.xml (Struts and Spring) and tiles-pages.xml (Spring only).
evidence: jsps.json (no export attribute on dt:table; 8 tables)

items.title: Daily missing-time-entry notification job
items.detail: Spring task:scheduled runs missingTimeEntryNotifier.execute at cron '0 5 0 * * *' (00:05 daily, scheduler pool 10): e-mails acceptors of incomplete tasks in active iterations with no time entry since the shifted date (projects with send-notification) and e-mails project notification receivers a summary; uses EmailResourceBundle subjects and email_notifications.vm, fetching email.css from xplanner.application.url.
items.uncertainty: Runs outside a request; EmailMessageImpl uses ThreadSession.get(), which may be unbound; with duplicate contexts (A-014) the job may run twice.

items.title: Quartz data-sampling job defined but not scheduled
items.detail: JobDetailBean datasamplingJob and CronTriggerBean '0 55 23 ? 1-12 *' are defined, but the SchedulerFactoryBean that would register the trigger is commented out; no other scheduler references the trigger, so nightly sampling does not run.
evidence: WEB-INF/classes/xplanner.properties:231-246 (quartz properties, consumer only in the commented bean)

items.title: Task executor and HSQLDB server
items.detail: task:executor 'executor' (pool 10) has no consumer found; in-process HSQLDB server starts only for databasetype hsqldb (not the shipped value).

items.title: SMTP e-mail sending
items.detail: javax.mail MimeMessage with HTML body part and optional file attachments, Transport.send; recipients resolved from Person.email via ObjectRepository (error when missing). Used by task create/update notifications, integration events and the daily job.

items.title: Outbound HTTP client
items.detail: com.technoetic.xplanner.util.HttpClient (java.net.URL) is used by GenericWikiAdapter (topic existence) and EmailFormatterImpl (email stylesheet).

items.title: Optional directory/SSO authentication integrations
items.detail: JNDI/LDAP authenticator (com.sabre.security.jndi), JAAS adapter and NTLM (jcifs) login modules are packaged and defined as prototype beans but not configured (A-026).

items.title: Office/project file formats
items.detail: MS Project MPX/MSPDI via mpxj, PDF via iText and JasperReports, Excel import via POI HSSF, CSV people import; downloadable import templates files/peopleImportTemplate.xls and files/storiesImportTemplate.xls.

items.title: Standalone utilities and commented wiring
items.detail: Classes with main() not wired into the web app: TomcatUserImporter, BootstrapSystemUser (autopatch task), HsqlServer, tacitknowledge StandaloneMigrationLauncher/HsqlAwareStandaloneMigrationLauncher/UpdatePatchLevel/MigrationInformation (xplanner.migration.patchpath refers to packages com.technoetic.xplanner.upgrade and patches that are absent), XPlannerLoginModule.main (prints an encoded sample password), XPlannerProperties.main, IdGenerator.main, TransformingSchemaExport. Also commented: NullSecurityFilter, XFire, JAX-WS servlet/listener; sun-jaxws.xml references a non-existent net.sf.xplanner.soap.XPlanner.

items.title: Client-side scripts and assets
items.detail: jQuery 1.5.1 + jQuery UI 1.8.11 (sortable reorder), jqote2 templates (dashboard), dojo xd + dojox charting theme, swfobject + flash/Dashboard.swf and expressInstall.swf (no JSP reference found), jscalendar with en/fr/it/ro and calendar-i18n.jsp, editTimeEntries.js / time.js (time entry form helpers), toggle.js, tooltip.js, nifty.js, overlib.js (chart tooltips), global.js, css themes.
items.uncertainty: Flash dashboard consumer not found (grep for Dashboard.swf/swfobject in JSPs returned none).

items.title: Page inventory
items.detail: 77 page files: 73 JSP (WEB-INF/jsp common 7, edit 16, import 1, layout 7, security 1, view 28 + view/iteration 3, wap 8; index.jsp; calendar-i18n.jsp), 1 tag file, 3 HTML (dragdrop.html, calendar/cal.html, js/chart.html). Per-page includes, forms, links, DB tags and scriptlet calls are listed in jsps.json.
items.uncertainty: Scenario-level behavior of every JSP fragment is not individually itemized beyond A-050..A-103.

coverage_notes.route_coverage: All 87 Struts routes are listed in routes.json and grouped into items A-021, A-025, A-029, A-050..A-094. REST (4 endpoints) A-097; SOAP A-098/A-099; iCal A-100; Spring MVC A-096; Cewolf A-101; public files A-102/A-103/A-161.
not_inspected: body text of 11 message bundles (keys used as evidence only where cited)
third-party jar internals except spring-struts DelegatingTilesRequestProcessor
full per-branch semantics of domain calculation getters (Iteration/UserStory/Task hour metrics)
JSP scriptlet logic beyond the scanned call patterns
coverage_notes.runtime: No runtime observation; every behavior needs Stage 3 confirmation.
